basic_details.short_information: KGBV Bareilly Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released by the Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Samagra Shiksha, Bareilly. A total of 101 vacancies have been announced through the KGBV Bareilly Recruitment 2026 for various teaching and non-teaching posts, including Principal, PGT, Lab Assistant, Office Superintendent/Clerk, Caretaker, Peon, Watchman, and Cook.

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format from the Bareilly NIC website, www.bareilly.nic.in, where the notification and guidelines are also available.
Fill the application form clearly and completely in your own handwriting. Cutting and overwriting are not permitted.
Write your name and father's name, and date of birth, exactly as recorded in your High School certificate.

Attach self-attested photocopies of: two recent self-attested colour photographs, educational certificates and mark sheets (all years of Graduation, Postgraduation, and B.Ed.), experience certificate, general residence (domicile) certificate, caste certificate issued by a competent authority, two character certificates issued by gazetted officers, Aadhaar card, and other relevant documents.
Enclose two self-addressed envelopes bearing adequate postage stamps for speed post/registered post.
Clearly mention, in bold letters on the envelope, the post/subject/category for which you are applying at the Kasturba Gandhi Awasiya Balika Vidyalaya.
If applying for more than one post, submit a separate application for each post, clearly mentioning the post name, subject and reservation category on each.

Send the completed application only by registered post or speed post to the Office of the District Basic Education Officer, Bareilly, so as to reach by 8 August 2026, 5:00 PM. Applications sent by ordinary post or courier will not be accepted.

The application form asks for details such as district name, post applied for, subject, candidate's name, father's name, date of birth, permanent and correspondence address, phone number, email ID, category, Aadhaar number, educational qualification details (Class 8 through postgraduate/B.Ed./Diploma), and teaching experience details, followed by a signed declaration.
important_instructions: All posts under this notification are reserved exclusively for women candidates. The maximum age for serving in a Kasturba Gandhi Awasiya Balika Vidyalaya is 60 years. Selection of teaching and non-teaching staff in the upgraded KGBVs will be on a contract basis for a period of 11 months 29 days. If a working teacher's performance is found satisfactory, a new contract of 11 months 29 days will be issued for the following academic session after approval of the District Magistrate - meaning a fresh service contract is executed every year. The annual evaluation of a teacher's work and conduct will be carried out by the concerned Block Education Officer. The contract will provide that if services are found unsuitable, they may be terminated by giving one month's notice. In cases of serious circumstances, financial irregularity, or serious indiscipline, the District Basic Education Officer may place substantiated evidence before the District Magistrate, and upon approval, the contract may be terminated along with lodging of a First Information Report (FIR) against the concerned person. Incomplete, erroneous, unclear, unsigned, or improperly formatted applications, or those lacking required enclosures, will be rejected and will not be considered. Applications where only photocopies of certificates are sent by registered/speed post, without the original application form being filled and attached, will be treated as rejected. The district-level selection committee reserves the right to cancel the notification at any time, and no claim in this regard will be entertained. Full authority for any changes or corrections rests with the district-level selection committee. The number of posts advertised may increase or decrease. Clerical errors, if any, will be condoned.
Candidates who have completed their B.Ed. or postgraduate degree can also explore more B.Ed Government Jobs and Postgraduate Teacher (PGT) Jobs available across India.

Candidates looking for more women-only government job opportunities can also explore the latest Uttar Pradesh Government Jobs across various departments. content_sections.heading: KGBV Bareilly Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Notification release date: 24 July 2026 Age reckoning date: 1 April 2026 (age and qualification marks are calculated as per the certificates as on this date) Last date to submit application (by registered/speed post): 8 August 2026, till 5:00 PM The notification does not mention any separate date for admit card, exam, or interview; these will likely be communicated post application scrutiny.

content_sections.heading: KGBV Bareilly Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 90 posts are advertised across 14 categories in 5 newly upgraded KGBV schools, as shown below. In addition, 11 vacancies remaining from an earlier notification (No. 4319-C/2024-25 and 4320-C/2024-25, both dated 17.01.2025) have also been included in this recruitment cycle: Separately, the notification states that a newly constructed hostel (for classes 6 to 8) attached to an existing KGBV also requires full-time staff - Caretaker, Peon, Watchman and Cook - for whom night stay at the school is compulsory, and candidates must not have any physical disability or infectious disease. The exact number of posts for this hostel is not specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: KGBV Bareilly Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Vacancies will be calculated post-wise, subject-wise, and category-wise at the district level, and applications will be invited accordingly. A separate merit list will be prepared post-wise, subject-wise and category-wise for selecting candidates. For Peon, Watchman and Cook posts, selection will be based on an interview. For other posts, candidates will be ranked using the following quality-marks weightage: If two or more candidates secure equal quality marks, the older candidate (by age) will be ranked higher in the merit list. If quality marks and age are also equal, candidates will be ranked in alphabetical order of their name (in English). Certificates submitted by shortlisted candidates for teaching and non-teaching posts will be verified from the concerned board/institution, and original educational records will be kept secured with the District Project Office. Honorarium will be paid only after this verification is complete.
